title: Large generated repository refactor
spec: Create a TypeScript repository generator that produces 2,000 small source modules across 80 packages with a dependency graph and tests. Then perform a cross-cutting API migration without broad dependency-directory scans. The repository must provide deterministic generation, typecheck, test, migration validation, and stale-symbol detection scripts.
prompts: Create the deterministic repository generator, package graph manifest, shared API v1, and smoke tests. Generate all 2,000 modules.
Add graph-aware validation, targeted package tests, full typecheck, and intentional fixture failures proving the validators work.
Migrate the shared API from positional parameters to an options object across generated packages while preserving compatibility at the boundary.
Remove the compatibility layer, update tests and documentation, and prove no stale call sites remain using scoped searches.
Run deterministic regeneration checks, stale-symbol validation, tests, and typecheck. Fix failures and write BENCHMARK_RESULTS.md with command counts and timing.
